sentences.text:
Global Wealth Management remained the bank's primary growth engine, with total invested assets reaching a record $7.3 trillion at the end of June, supported by strong client inflows
The Credit Suisse integration is nearing completion, which removes execution risk and releases costs.

UBS completed the global migration of former Credit Suisse client accounts in March 2026, cumulative gross savings reached $12.6 billion by the end of the second quarter against a roughly $13.5 billion year-end goal, and the integration is still expected to be substantially complete before 2027.

Profitability targets are stepping up, as UBS targets a 2026 underlying return on CET1 capital of about 13% and a cost-income ratio near 73%, and by 2028 a reported return on CET1 capital of 18% with a 67% cost-income ratio.
